independence.rule: Every preset is addressed as slot:preset and rewrites only that slot's glTF material entry. No two slots share a glTF material index, so applying a preset cannot recolor another slot.

lighting.note: No project lighting rig exists until PROOF-SCENE defines it. Readability here is the neutral-light static proxy: mid-range albedo luminance, non-flat response, no crushed blacks/whites, dielectric PBR, normal detail present. Rendered under-lighting readability stays pending on TOOLCHAIN plus PROOF-SCENE.

readability.rationale: sRGB-luma bands for neutral-light readability: albedo means stay clear of crushed black and blown white, std proves the map carries shading response instead of a flat fill, crush fractions cap dead pixels. Measured 2026-10-27 with stdlib PNG decode; bands are readability criteria, not tight regressions.
